summary.name: SRE Hiring
summary.one_liner: A 2015 SREcon talk by Andrew Fong of Dropbox on recruiting, evaluating, and hiring site reliability engineers.
use_cases: Planning how to recruit site reliability engineers
Designing an SRE interview and evaluation process
Learning how Dropbox built its SRE foundation
Researching best practices for hiring SREs
summary.what_it_does: The page is the listing for a SREcon15 conference talk titled "SRE Hiring" by Andrew Fong of Dropbox. The abstract says the talk covers best practices for recruiting, evaluating, and hiring SREs into an organization. It says the talk approaches the topic from first principles and describes how these practices were applied when building the foundation of SRE at Dropbox. Andrew Fong leads Dropbox's SRE teams; he previously worked at YouTube on infrastructure scaling and at AOL on proxy/cache and video search infrastructure. The page also gives citation details (USENIX Association, Santa Clara, March 2015).
notable: Practitioner talk from the Dropbox SRE lead on building an SRE team from scratch
Part of USENIX SREcon15, held at the Hyatt Regency Santa Clara
USENIX Open Access: post-event slides and video are free to access
caveats: Page text is an abstract and speaker bio only; no slides or video content is included in the text
Not a software tool; it is a conference talk listing
